messageHandlers.script:
from ata.toast.handler import toasts
	# Check for the incoming toast id in the props.instances and get the index of the instance
	index = self.getToastIndex(payload.get('toastID'))
	
	# If index exists either apply exit style or remove from instances
	if index != None:
		if bool(dict(self.custom.animation.value)):
			toastID = self.props.instances[index]['toastID']
			waitTime = int(self.custom.animation.value['exit']['animation-duration'].replace('s', ''))
			toasts.toastClearOut(toastID, waitTime)
			self.props.instances[index]['instanceStyle'] = self.custom.animation.value['exit']
		else:
			self.removeToast(index)
		
	# Reset the props.style zIndex to -1 (hidden behind everything else)
	if not bool(self.props.instances): 
		self.props.style.zIndex = -1

# Check for the incoming toast id in the props.instances and get the index of the instance
	index = self.getToastIndex(payload.get('toastID'))
	
	# Remove toast message from instances if exists
	if index != None:
		self.removeToast(index)
